[size=150][b]Lionheart Fixt 0.8.2 - repairs[/b][/size]

Repair only. Quinn's three reagent errands from 0.4.0, played through for the first time, and
one follow-up to 0.8.1.

[b]Quinn.[/b] A leftover [i]"[TEST] Give me a small amount of XP"[/i] reply is gone. Completed errands
are no longer offered a second time. Turning in too few reagents no longer costs you the ones
you had -- he counts first, and pushes a short delivery back across the bench. A Trapper's
quality pelts are accepted from every greeting, not just the first. And his reserve, which was
supposed to open after the first errand, actually does -- including on saves where it already
failed to.

[b]Fernand's draught can be drunk.[/b] 0.8.1 made it an undrinkable quest item, which removed the
choice. It is a real Extra Healing potion again. Drink it and you cannot save Juan.

[b]Fixt[/b] is a cumulative restoration-and-repair mod for Lionheart, after Fallout Fixt.

Download, unzip, run [i]Mod Manager.bat[/i]. It installs over 0.8.1 as normal. The Quinn fixes take
effect on any save; the draught change needs a character who has not yet taken Fernand's job.
